skillTypes.heading: Common and Special Skills in Infinity

descriptions.singular: An Automatic Skill can be employed without expending an Order or ARO.
descriptions.plural: Automatic Skills can be employed without expending an Order or ARO.

descriptions.singular: A Deployment Skill is used during the Deployment Phase or when a Trooper is deployed.
descriptions.plural: Deployment Skills are used during the Deployment Phase or when Troopers are deployed.

descriptions.singular: A Basic Short Skill expends one Basic Short Skill.
descriptions.plural: Basic Short Skills expend one Basic Short Skill.

descriptions.singular: A Short Skill expends one Short Skill.
descriptions.plural: Short Skills expend one Short Skill.

descriptions.singular: A Long Skill expends the entire Order and can only be declared in the Active Turn.
descriptions.plural: Long Skills expend the entire Order and can only be declared in the Active Turn.

descriptions.singular: An ARO Skill is one that a Trooper may perform as an ARO.
descriptions.plural: ARO Skills are those that Troopers may perform as an ARO.

labels.name: Airborne Deployment (AD)
labels.description: Encompasses Skills related to Airborne Infantry.

labels.name: Assignable (Transmutation)
labels.description: Allows certain weapons or Equipment to be assigned to Troopers with [[skill:transmutation]] (X).

labels.name: Attack
labels.description: The use of the Special Skill or Equipment is considered an Attack.

labels.name: BS Attack
labels.description: The use of the Special Skill or Equipment is a form of [[skill:bs-attack]].

labels.name: CC Attack
labels.description: The use of the Special Skill or Equipment is a form of [[skill:cc-attack]].

labels.name: CC Special Skill
labels.description: The Skill can only be used when the user is in Silhouette contact with the target.

labels.name: Comms Attack
labels.description: The weapon, Special Skill, or Equipment is an Attack avoided with [[skill:reset]] rather than [[skill:dodge]].

labels.name: Comms Equipment
labels.description: Equipment vulnerable to certain Hacking Programs and Ammunition.

labels.name: Hackable
labels.description: A Trooper, Peripheral, weapon, or Equipment that can be targeted by certain Hacking Programs.

labels.name: Hostile
labels.description: A game element with its own Attributes that belongs to neither player's Army List.

labels.name: Optional
labels.description: The use of this Special Skill or Equipment is optional and can be waived.

labels.name: Marker
labels.description: This label indicates that a Trooper, weapon, or piece of equipment can be represented by a Marker.

labels.name: Movement
labels.description: The use of the Skill or Equipment is a form of Movement.

labels.name: Negative Feedback (NFB)
labels.description: The Skill or Equipment is incompatible with another element having the same Label or Trait.

labels.name: No LoF
labels.description: The Skill does not require Line of Fire to the target.

labels.name: Non-Reloadable
labels.description: An [[state:unloaded]] cannot be canceled and expended uses cannot be regained.

labels.name: No Roll
labels.description: The weapon, Special Skill, or Equipment works automatically without requiring a Roll.

labels.name: Null
labels.description: A State with this Label does not provide an Order or Victory Points.

labels.name: Obligatory
labels.description: The use of the Special Skill or Equipment is compulsory and cannot be waived.

labels.name: Private Information
labels.description: Whether Troopers have this Label is Private Information until it is used or the game ends.

labels.name: States Phase
labels.description: The Equipment or Skill can only be used during the States Phase unless stated otherwise.

labels.name: Superior Deployment
labels.description: Encompasses Skills that allow Troopers to deploy outside their Deployment Zone.

labels.name: Supportware
labels.description: Hacking Programs that provide support to Allied Troopers or interfere with enemies.

labels.name: FAQs
labels.description: A label category for FAQ-related rule references.

records.name: Movement (MOV)
records.summary: Movement (MOV) is the distance a Trooper can move in an Order. It normally has separate first-move and second-move values; a dash means the Trooper is stationary.

records.name: Close Combat (CC)
records.summary: Close Combat (CC) measures a Trooper's capability in hand-to-hand combat.

records.name: Ballistic Skills (BS)
records.summary: Ballistic Skills (BS) measures a Trooper's capability in ranged combat.

records.name: Physique (PH)
records.summary: Physique (PH) represents a Trooper's physical capability, including strength, dexterity, throwing, and dodging.

records.name: Willpower (WIP)
records.summary: Willpower (WIP) represents a Trooper's mental capability for tasks such as detection, medical actions, and hacking.

records.name: Armor (ARM)
records.summary: Armor (ARM) measures a Trooper's overall armor protection; higher values provide more effective protection against damaging attacks.

records.name: Bio-Technological Shield (BTS)
records.summary: Bio-Technological Shield (BTS) measures a Trooper's NBC, nanotechnological, electromagnetic, and anti-hacking protection.

records.name: Vitality (VITA)
records.summary: Vitality (VITA) represents a Trooper's physical endurance and how much punishment it can withstand before losing consciousness or dying.

records.name: Structure (STR)
records.summary: Structure (STR) is the alternative durability Attribute used by mechanical Troopers and some scenery structures.

records.name: Availability (AVA)
records.summary: Availability (AVA) is the number of Troopers from a Unit allowed in a single Army List.

records.name: Silhouette (S)
records.summary: Silhouette (S) identifies the Silhouette Template used to represent a Trooper's three-dimensional volume for game purposes.

records.name: Support Weapons Cost (SWC)
records.summary: Support Weapons Cost (SWC) is the Support Weapon Point cost paid when adding the Trooper to an Army List.

records.name: Cost (C)
records.summary: Cost (C) is the Trooper's Army Points value including its Special Skills, Weapons, and Equipment.

records.name: Model
records.summary: A Model is a game element with Attributes represented on the game table by a miniature.

records.name: Marker
records.summary: A Marker is a game element with Attributes represented by a Marker when a Skill, Weapon, or Equipment rule allows that representation.

records.name: Token
records.summary: A Token represents a [[trait:deployable|Deployable]] Weapon or piece of Equipment on the battlefield.

records.name: State Token
records.summary: This token is a reminder placed to indicate the effect of a rule, Skill, or game state; it does not replace the identity of the affected game element.

records.name: Deployable Equipment
records.summary: Equipment with the [[trait:deployable|Deployable]] Trait can be placed as an independent battlefield game element with its own Attributes and can be targeted.

records.name: Deployable Weapon
records.summary: A Weapon with the [[trait:deployable|Deployable]] Trait can be placed as an independent battlefield game element with its own Attributes and can be targeted.

records.name: Peripheral
records.summary: A [[skill:peripheral|Peripheral]] is a Trooper associated with a Controller. The Special Skill defines the common Controller relationship and the core peripheral types.

records.name: Scenery Element
records.summary: A Scenery Element is a battlefield game element representing scenery or terrain; rules may give it Attributes or make it a target.

records.name: Target
records.summary: A Target is the game element designated by a Skill or Attack as the subject of its effects.

records.name: Trooper
records.summary: A Trooper is a game element represented by a Unit Profile and belonging to a player’s force.

records.name: Unit Profile
records.summary: A Unit Profile is the rules data that defines a Trooper’s Attributes, Skills, Equipment, Weapons, and selectable options.

records.name: FTO (Fireteam Option)
records.summary: FTO (Fireteam Option) is an identifier suffix on Unit Profile options, not a rule with effects of its own. If a Fireteams Chart requires FTO for a Unit, only options with FTO in their option name can join that Fireteam; if it requires a specific form such as FTO-2, only that named option qualifies.

records.name: Victory Points
records.summary: Victory Points are the combined Cost of a player’s Troopers that are in a non-null state. They depend on current game state as well as Army List Cost rather than being a static Unit or profile value.

records.name: Null State
records.summary: A null-classified state is one carrying the Null Label. Troopers in such a state do not provide Orders or Victory Points.

records.name: Ally
records.summary: An Ally is a game element belonging to the player’s side. Alignment is contextual to the players’ Army Lists rather than inferred from faction identity alone.

records.name: Enemy
records.summary: An Enemy is a game element belonging to the opposing player’s side. Alignment is contextual to the players’ Army Lists rather than inferred from faction identity alone.

records.name: Hostile
records.summary: A Hostile game element belongs to neither player’s Army List but is treated as an Enemy by both players and can declare or receive Attacks.

records.name: Neutral
records.summary: A Neutral game element belongs to neither player’s Army List and does not gain the additional Hostile rule that makes it an Enemy to both players.

records.name: Camouflaged State
records.summary: A Marker State that hides the represented Trooper, Weapon, or Equipment until it is revealed by [[skill:discover]] or another rule.

effects: The represented game element is replaced by a Camouflaged Marker while the State is active.
A successful [[skill:discover]] Roll reveals the Marker and replaces it with the corresponding Model or Token.
A Camouflaged Marker may carry the user's [[skill:mimetism]] MOD and has 360-degree Line of Fire.
requirements: The game element has the [[skill:camouflage]] Special Skill.
restrictions: Enemy Troopers cannot declare Attacks against a Camouflaged Marker unless another rule allows it; the Marker must normally be Discovered first.
Enemy Troopers cannot enter Silhouette contact with a Camouflaged Marker.
A Trooper in Camouflaged State cannot be part of a Fireteam.
During the Active Turn, a [[skill:camouflage]] user may regain this State only with the required Long Skill while outside the LoF of enemy Models and Markers.

records.name: Camouflage
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that lets its user deploy in and later enter [[state:camouflaged]].

effects: During the Deployment Phase, the user may deploy in [[state:camouflaged]].
During the game, the user may enter [[state:camouflaged]] under that State's activation conditions.

records.name: Discover
records.summary: A Common Skill used to reveal game elements represented by Markers.

requirements: The user must meet the target and visibility requirements for the Marker.
effects: The user makes the required WIP Roll to reveal an eligible Marker.
restrictions: The Marker State and other rules determine the Roll MODs and result.

records.name: Super-Jump
records.summary: A Special Skill that modifies [[skill:jump]] and can add a listed Unit Profile distance to a [[skill:jump]].

effects: If [[skill:jump]] is declared as the first Basic Short Skill of the Order, Super-Jump turns [[skill:jump]] from a Long Skill into a Basic Short Skill and allows another compatible Basic Short or Short Skill in the same Order.

A Long Skill [[skill:jump|Jump]] uses the first MOV value plus [[distance:4:inch]]; when Super-Jump has a Unit Profile distance, a Short Skill [[skill:jump]] adds that distance instead of [[skill:jump]]'s usual [[distance:2:inch]].
restrictions: [[skill:jump]] can be declared as a Basic Short Skill only once per Order, and the user cannot benefit from Partial Cover MODs while declaring [[skill:jump]].

records.name: Forward Deployment
records.summary: A Deployment Skill that allows deployment beyond the Deployment Zone by the distance listed in the Unit Profile.

requirements: The user must deploy during the Deployment Phase.
effects: The user may deploy beyond their Deployment Zone by the distance listed in the Unit Profile.
restrictions: The listed distance and all normal Deployment restrictions limit the placement.

records.name: Anti-materiel
records.summary: Its Special Ammunition can affect structures and scenery.

records.name: ARM = 0
records.summary: Reduces the target's ARM Attribute to 0 for Saving Rolls.

records.name: ARO
records.summary: Only usable in ARO.

records.name: BioWeapon
records.summary: Applies DA+Shock Special Ammunition against targets with VITA.

records.name: Boost
records.summary:
Once in play, a Boost weapon must trigger when an enemy Model declares or performs an Order or Automatic Reaction Order in its [[trait:zone-of-control-zc|Zone of Control]]; it advances into Silhouette contact, detonates, and is removed.

Only a successful [[skill:dodge]] Roll resolved without opposition avoids this attack.

The weapon does not trigger if an obstacle or too-small gap blocks its path, or for [[state:camouflaged|CAMO]], [[state:impersonation-1|IMP-1]], [[state:impersonation-2|IMP-2]], and other exempt Markers.

Because it is [[trait:deployable|Deployable]], it cannot activate other [[trait:deployable|Deployable]] Weapons or Equipment.

records.name: BS Weapon (PH)
records.summary: Makes [[skill:bs-attack:plural]] using PH instead of BS; BS rules and MODs affect PH instead.

records.name: BS Weapon (WIP)
records.summary: Makes [[skill:bs-attack:plural]] using WIP instead of BS; BS rules and MODs affect WIP instead.

records.name: BTS = 0
records.summary: Reduces the target's BTS Attribute to 0 for Saving Rolls.

records.name: Burst (B)
records.summary: Indicates how many dice are rolled when using the weapon or piece of Equipment.

records.name: Burst: Single Target
records.summary: All shots in the Burst must choose one target.

records.name: CC
records.summary: Can be used to make [[skill:cc-attack:plural]].

records.name: Concealed
records.summary: Uses the effects of [[state:camouflaged]]; its concealing marker has Silhouette 2.

records.name: Continuous Damage
records.summary: After a failed Saving Roll, the target keeps making Saving Rolls until one succeeds or it enters [[state:dead]].

records.name: Deployable
records.summary: May be deployed as an independent battlefield element with its own profile and Attributes.

records.name: Direct Template
records.summary: Uses Direct Template rules, firing the indicated Template.

records.name: Disposable (X)
records.summary: Has limited uses. Each use is expended when declared, and all modes share the available uses.

records.name: Double Shot
records.summary: In the Active Turn, may apply +1 Burst; with Disposable (2), this spends both uses.

records.name: Impact Template
records.summary: Places the indicated Template at the point of impact.

records.name: Improvised
records.summary: Imposes a -6 MOD to the user's relevant Attribute.

records.name: Indiscriminate
records.summary: May be used or deployed despite Camouflage and Hiding Markers in its Area of Effect.

records.name: Intuitive Attack
records.summary: Can be used to make [[skill:intuitive-attack:plural]].

records.name: Non-Lethal
records.summary: Prevents this Weapon, Equipment, or Hacking Program from inflicting Wounds, even when other Ammunition is added or combined. Non-Lethal does not by itself remove Saving Rolls: some attacks require them to determine non-Wound effects such as [[state:isolated|Isolated]] or [[state:immobilized-a|Immobilized-A]].

records.name: Non-Reloadable
records.summary: Its expended Disposable uses cannot be regained.

records.name: Perimeter
records.summary: When placed, applies [[trait:deployable|Deployable]] and Perimeter, placing it completely inside the user's Zone of Control.

records.name: Prior Deployment
records.summary: Must be placed during the Deployment Phase.

records.name: Reflective
records.summary: Also affects Troopers with [[skill:marksmanship]], [[equipment:multispectral-visor:plural]], or specified equivalent Equipment.

records.name: Silent (X)
records.summary: When used inside the target's Zone of Control but outside LoF, applies its bracketed MOD to Face to Face [[skill:dodge]] Rolls.

records.name: Speculative Attack
records.summary: Can be used to make [[skill:speculative-attack:plural]].

records.name: State
records.summary: Causes the target to enter the Game State indicated in its profile.

records.name: Suppressive Fire (SF)
records.summary: Allows the user to enter [[state:suppressive-fire]] and use its SF Mode profile.

records.name: Target (Attribute)
records.summary: Only affects targets with the indicated VITA or STR Attribute.

records.name: Targetless
records.summary: Can fire without designating an enemy target; in the Reactive Turn it requires LoF to the Active Trooper.

records.name: Zone of Control (ZoC)
records.summary: Its range is the user's Zone of Control ([[distance:8:inch]]).

records.name: Armed Turret
records.summary: A stationary [[trait:deployable]] Weapon that reacts to enemy Orders.

records.name: Sepsitor
records.summary:
Sepsitor is a [[trait:direct-template|Direct Template]] weapon that can affect Troopers with a [[equipment:cube|Cube]] or equivalent Equipment.

A hit requires a BTS Saving Roll using the weapon’s PS 4; a Critical causes an additional Saving Roll, and failure causes [[state:sepsitorized|Sepsitorized State]].

It has [[trait:disposable-x|Disposable (2)]]. [[equipment:cube-2|Cube 2.0]] grants +2 to its user’s Saving Roll against this attack.

[[weapon:sepsitor-plus|Sepsitor Plus]] has its own weapon profile; do not apply Sepsitor’s PS or Disposable limit to that weapon.

records.name: Sepsitor Plus
records.summary:
Sepsitor Plus uses the [[trait:direct-template|Direct Template]] rules described in the N5 Weaponry section against Troopers with a [[equipment:cube|Cube]] or equivalent Equipment.

A hit requires a BTS Saving Roll using this weapon’s PS 3; a Critical causes an additional Saving Roll, and failure causes [[state:sepsitorized|Sepsitorized State]].

[[equipment:cube-2|Cube 2.0]] grants +2 to its user’s Saving Roll against this attack. Unlike [[weapon:sepsitor|Sepsitor]], Sepsitor Plus does not list Disposable (2).

sourceNotes: The N5 v5.3 Weapon Chart includes a [*] reference to the N5 Weaponry rules for this weapon, but the imported Army profile omits that marker; both sources retain their original values.

records.name: Pheroware Tactics (PT)

sourceNotes: The N5 v5.3 chart classifiestheir attacks as [[trait:bs-weapon-wip|BS Weapon (WIP)]], replacing the older [[trait:bs-weapon-wip|Technical Weapon]] label still present in the imported Army profiles.

records.summary: The Pheroware Tactics (PT) profiles—Endgame, Eraser, and Mirrorball—are distinct weapons. Their individual effects must be read from their own profiles; Endgame’s [[trait:double-shot|Double Shot]] does not apply to Eraser or Mirrorball.

records.name: PT: Endgame
records.summary: In the N5 v5.3 Weapon Chart, PT: Endgame has [[trait:double-shot|Double Shot]]. During the Active Turn it may gain +1 Burst by using both charges of [[trait:disposable-x|Disposable (2)]]. Its base Burst remains 1.

effects: In the Active Turn, [[trait:double-shot|Double Shot]] may add +1 Burst at the cost of both [[trait:disposable-x|Disposable (2)]] uses; this applies to Endgame, not other PT profiles.
sourceNotes: The imported Army snapshot retains the legacy [[trait:bs-weapon-wip|Technical Weapon]] label and omits [[trait:double-shot|Double Shot]], while the N5 chart uses [[trait:bs-weapon-wip|BS Weapon (WIP)]] and includes [[trait:double-shot|Double Shot]]. This is an explicit source discrepancy; the imported Army properties are not altered.

records.name: Kobra Pistol
records.summary:
Kobra Pistol is a Mixed Weapon with two separate modes.

**BS Mode:** Uses [[ammunition:shock|Shock Ammunition]] and the Trooper’s BS Attribute.

**[[trait:cc|CC]] Mode:** Uses [[ammunition:da|Double Action (DA) Ammunition]] and the Trooper’s [[trait:cc|CC]] Attribute.

The individual mode profiles, not this shared description, determine their Traits and Saving Rolls.

records.name: Kobra Pistol (CC Mode)
records.summary:
[[weapon:kobra-pistol|Kobra Pistol]] has separate BS and [[trait:cc|CC]] modes. In [[trait:cc|CC]] Mode it uses [[ammunition:da|Double Action (DA) Ammunition]], which requires two ARM Saving Rolls per hit. 

The BS Mode instead uses [[ammunition:shock|Shock Ammunition]] and does not inherit this [[trait:cc|CC]]-specific reference.

sourceNotes: The N5 v5.3 Weapon Chart printsone Saving Roll for this mode, while the DA rule, imported Army profile, and reviewed N5.3 Wiki chart support two. The current Army profile and reviewed Wiki also list [[trait:anti-materiel|Anti-materiel]] for [[trait:cc|CC]] Mode, but the printed v5.3 chart omits that Trait. Its applicability remains an unresolved source discrepancy; this reference does not add or remove that Trait from the Army profile.

records.name: Drop Bears
records.summary:
Drop Bears have two different deployment modes, with three shared [[trait:disposable-x|Disposable (3)]] uses.

**[[trait:deployable|Deployable]] Mode:** Use [[skill:place-deployable|Place Deployable]] or [[skill:intuitive-attack|Intuitive Attack]] to place a visible Mine Token (Mine -3), not a [[skill:camouflage|Camouflage]] Marker. The deployed Drop Bear uses its own [[ammunition:shock|Shock]] weapon profile.

**BS Mode:** Throw the Drop Bear using [[trait:bs-weapon-ph|BS Weapon (PH)]]; [[trait:targetless|Targetless]] means no target is needed. A successful Roll deploys the Mine Token during the Conclusion step; it cannot detonate during the Order in which it was thrown.

In BS Mode, it cannot be placed with an enemy [[skill:camouflage|Camouflage]] Marker inside its Trigger Area unless a valid, non-camouflaged enemy is also inside. After placement the Token functions as a Mine, subject to these Drop Bear-specific exceptions.

sourceNotes: The N5 v5.3 chart classifies the thrown mode as [[trait:bs-weapon-ph|BS Weapon (PH)]], but Army additionally retains the legacy [[trait:bs-weapon-ph|Throwing Weapon]] label. That older label is source metadata, not an additional N5 effect.

records.name: WildParrot
records.summary:
WildParrots are placed using [[skill:place-deployable]] or [[skill:intuitive-attack|Intuitive Attack]].

The [[trait:perimeter|Perimeter]] rule places them completely inside the user’s [[trait:zone-of-control-zc|Zone of Control]] instead of in Silhouette contact.

Once deployed, they work like [[weapon:mines|E/M Mines]], but place a visible WildParrot Token or Model instead of a [[skill:camouflage|Camouflage]] Marker.

Unlike [[trait:boost|Boost]] devices such as Crazykoalas and Madtraps, WildParrots do not have that Trait; they follow their own E/M weapon profile (BTS/2, two Saving Rolls).

sourceNotes: The printed N5 v5.3 Weapon Chart specifies [[trait:non-lethal|Non-Lethal]], which is absent from the current imported Army Trait list. That source discrepancy is retained rather than silently changing the Army profile.

records.name: Mines
records.summary:
Mine types governed by these shared rules use [[skill:place-deployable]] to put down a [[skill:camouflage|CAMO]] (-3) Marker, which becomes a MINE (-3) Token when Discovered; both receive [[skill:mimetism]] (-3).

Mines have 360º LoF. Their Trigger Area is the Small Teardrop Template projected from the base, excluding Total Cover.

When an enemy Model or Marker declares or executes a Skill or [[trait:aro|ARO]] within it, a Mine must trigger if its Small Teardrop Template reaches that enemy without affecting any ally, including [[state:unconscious|Unconscious]] allies. If the target is outside the Trigger Area, the Mine remains hidden and does not detonate.

Each named Mine has its own Weapon Chart ammunition, PS, Saving Rolls, and Traits; a triggered Mine applies its own profile and is then removed. Mines that can be Dodged impose -3 PH on [[skill:dodge]] attempts.

A Mine cannot be placed with an enemy [[skill:camouflage|Camouflage]] Marker inside its Trigger Area unless a valid non-camouflaged enemy is also inside it or a [[trait:intuitive-attack|Intuitive Attack]] was declared.

[[weapon:cybermine|Cybermines]] replace the [[skill:dodge|Dodge]] response with [[skill:reset]]; [[weapon:chest-mine|Chest Mines]] do not use these shared Mine rules.

records.name: PARA Mine
records.summary: This weapon uses the shared [[weapon:mines|Mines]] placement and triggering rules. Hits use [[ammunition:para|Paralysis (PARA) Ammunition]]: a PH-6 Saving Roll, with failure causing [[state:immobilized-a|Immobilized-A]], rather than Wounds.

sourceNotes: The N5 v5.3 Weapon Chart and reviewed Wiki mark its profile [*], which the N5.3 legend defines as a reference to additional Weaponry rules. The imported Army profile instead has [**], which the N5.3 legend assigns to Ammunition rules. Both the Mine mechanics and PARA ammunition apply. The marker difference is an unresolved source-reference discrepancy; the Army profile is retained unchanged.

records.name: Cybermine
records.summary:
Cybermines use the shared [[weapon:mines|Mines]] placement and triggering mechanics, but have their own Comms Attack effects.

They can be avoided only with [[skill:reset]] at -3 WIP, not [[skill:dodge]].

A hit forces two BTS Saving Rolls against PS 5. Failure of either causes [[state:stunned]], or [[state:immobilized-b|Immobilized-B]] instead for a Hackable Trooper or [[skill:hacker|Hacker]].

records.name: Chest Mine
records.summary:
This weapon does not use the shared [[weapon:mines|Mines]] placement or triggering rules in either mode.

**BS Mode:** It functions as a [[trait:direct-template]] Weapon.

**[[trait:cc|CC]] Mode:** It is a [[trait:cc|CC]] Weapon: winning the Face to Face Roll affects every enemy Trooper in Silhouette contact with the bearer, but the [[skill:cc-attack|CC attack]] cannot be used while an ally is in Silhouette contact with the bearer.

Both modes share two uses under [[trait:disposable-x|Disposable (2)]]. Detonation does not affect the bearer.

records.name: Doctor
records.summary: A Short Special Skill that restores VITA-based allies and can cancel applicable states.

requirements: The target must be a friendly VITA-based Trooper in Silhouette contact with the user.
effects: A successful WIP Roll restores a lost Wound or cancels an applicable State.
restrictions: The target's State and the Doctor rule determine whether the Roll is permitted and its result.

records.name: Engineer
records.summary: A Short Special Skill that repairs STR-based allies and cancels applicable states.

requirements: The target must be a friendly STR-based Trooper, piece of Equipment, or Scenery item in Silhouette contact with the user.
effects: A successful WIP Roll restores a lost Structure or cancels an applicable State.
restrictions: The target's State and the Engineer rule determine whether the Roll is permitted and its result.

records.name: Cyberplug
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that grants access to [[skill:peripheral]] (Cyberplug) Troopers.

effects: The user has access to [[skill:peripheral]] (Cyberplug) Troopers as specified by the applicable profile.
restrictions: [[skill:peripheral]] (Cyberplug) rules and the profile's listed options govern the available Troopers.

records.name: Peripheral
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill defining common Controller/Peripheral behavior and the five core Peripheral types.

effects: The rule defines the Controller and Peripheral behavior for the applicable Peripheral type.
restrictions: The selected Peripheral type and its specific rules limit Controller and Peripheral actions.

records.name: Peripheral (Servant)
records.summary: A Peripheral type controlled by a [[skill:doctor]] or [[skill:engineer]], with unlimited operating distance and a maximum of two per Controller.

records.name: Peripheral (Synchronized)
records.summary: A Peripheral type whose operation depends on its Controller and Coherency; the core type rule states no generic Controller-eligibility predicate.

records.name: Peripheral (Control)
records.summary: A Peripheral type with unlimited operating distance and a maximum of three per Controller; the core type rule states no generic Controller-eligibility predicate.

records.name: Peripheral (Ancillary)
records.summary: A Peripheral type with unlimited operating distance that starts undeployed; the core type rule states no generic Controller-eligibility predicate.

records.name: Peripheral (Cyberplug)
records.summary: A Peripheral type granted by [[skill:cyberplug]], with unlimited operating distance, a maximum of two per Controller, and Connected/Autonomous operating profiles.

records.name: Regular
records.summary: The Trooper contributes its Regular Order to the appropriate Combat Group Order Pool under normal conditions.

records.name: Irregular
records.summary: The Trooper generates an Irregular Order that remains separate from the Combat Group Regular Order Pool.

records.name: Martial Arts
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill with discrete Levels; the exact Level listed for a Trooper determines the applicable Level effects.

requirements: The user must reach or be in Silhouette contact with the target and declare [[skill:cc-attack]].
effects: The Martial Arts Level listed in the Unit Profile supplies its defined Attack, Opponent, and Burst MODs for that Close Combat.
restrictions: Only the exact Level listed for the user applies.

records.name: Martial Arts L1
records.summary: Level 1 of [[skill:martial-arts]]. Levels are discrete rather than cumulative; use the effects listed for Level 1.

records.name: Martial Arts L2
records.summary: Level 2 of [[skill:martial-arts]]. Levels are discrete rather than cumulative; use the effects listed for Level 2.

records.name: Martial Arts L3
records.summary: Level 3 of [[skill:martial-arts]]. Levels are discrete rather than cumulative; use the effects listed for Level 3.

records.name: Martial Arts L4
records.summary: Level 4 of [[skill:martial-arts]]. Levels are discrete rather than cumulative; use the effects listed for Level 4.

records.name: Martial Arts L5
records.summary: Level 5 of [[skill:martial-arts]]. Levels are discrete rather than cumulative; use the effects listed for Level 5.

records.name: Strategos
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill with discrete Levels; the exact Level listed for a Trooper determines the applicable Strategos effects.

requirements: The user must be the army's [[skill:lieutenant]].
effects: The Strategos Level listed in the Unit Profile supplies its defined Deployment Phase and Order Count effects; Level 2 also supplies its Tactical Phase Combat Group transfer effect.
restrictions: Only the exact Level listed for the user applies.

records.name: Strategos L1
records.summary: Level 1 of [[skill:strategos]]. Levels are discrete rather than cumulative; use the effects listed for Level 1.

requirements: The user must be the army's [[skill:lieutenant]].
effects: During the Deployment Phase, the player may set aside two Troopers and their [[skill:peripheral|Peripherals]] to deploy after the opponent instead of the usual one.
At the beginning of the Active Turn, during Order Count, replace any Special Lieutenant Orders with Regular Orders and add them to the Order Pool of the [[skill:lieutenant]]'s Combat Group.

records.name: Strategos L2
records.summary: Level 2 of [[skill:strategos]]. Levels are discrete rather than cumulative; use the effects listed for Level 2.

requirements: The user must be the army's [[skill:lieutenant]].
effects: During the Tactical Phase's Executive Use of Command Tokens step, the user may transfer one Trooper and their [[skill:peripheral|Peripherals]] to a different Combat Group without spending a Command Token.
During the Deployment Phase, the player may set aside two Troopers and their [[skill:peripheral|Peripherals]] to deploy after the opponent instead of the usual one.
At the beginning of the Active Turn, during Order Count, replace any Special Lieutenant Orders with Regular Orders and add them to the Order Pool of the [[skill:lieutenant]]'s Combat Group.

records.name: BS Attack
records.summary: A Common Skill used to make [[skill:bs-attack:plural]]; some variants replace the user's [[attribute:bs|BS]] with the value listed for this Skill.

requirements: The user must select an eligible BS Weapon, Equipment item, or Skill and meet its targeting requirements.
effects: The user makes the attack using the selected item's profile and applicable Attributes, Burst, Ammunition, and MODs.
restrictions: The selected item's range, Line of Fire, target, and special rules limit the attack.

records.name: BS=12
records.summary: A [[skill:bs-attack]] variant that replaces the user's [[attribute:bs|BS]] with 12 when using this Skill.

records.name: BS=11
records.summary: A [[skill:bs-attack]] variant that replaces the user's [[attribute:bs|BS]] with 11 when using this Skill.

records.name: CC Attack
records.summary: A Common Skill used to make [[skill:cc-attack:plural]]; some variants replace the user's [[attribute:cc|CC]] with the value listed for this Skill.

requirements: The user must be in Silhouette contact with the target and select an eligible CC Weapon or rule.
effects: The user makes the attack using the selected item's profile and applicable CC, Ammunition, and MODs.
restrictions: The selected item's effects and close-combat rules limit the attack.

records.name: CC=21
records.summary: A [[skill:cc-attack]] variant that replaces the user's [[attribute:cc|CC]] with 21 when using this Skill.

records.name: Cube
records.summary: Automatic Equipment represented by a Unit Profile symbol that allows Command Token rerolls when [[skill:doctor]] or another recovery rule explicitly permits Cube rerolls.

effects: When [[skill:doctor]] or another Special Skill or piece of Equipment explicitly permits it, a Command Token may be spent to reroll the failed recovery Roll for a Trooper with a Cube.

records.name: Cube 2.0
records.summary: Automatic Equipment represented by a Unit Profile symbol that includes [[equipment:cube]] recovery rerolls and improves Saving Rolls against [[weapon:sepsitor|Sepsitor]] and [[weapon:sepsitor-plus|Sepsitor Plus]] attacks.

effects: When [[skill:doctor]] or another Special Skill or piece of Equipment explicitly permits it, a Command Token may be spent to reroll the failed recovery Roll for a Trooper with a Cube 2.0.
The user applies a +2 MOD to Saving Rolls against [[weapon:sepsitor|Sepsitor]] and [[weapon:sepsitor-plus|Sepsitor Plus]] attacks.

records.name: TinBot
records.summary: Automatic Equipment that grants its owner the MOD, Special Skill, or Equipment advantage listed for that [[equipment:tinbot]] option.

records.name: TinBot: Firewall
records.summary: A [[equipment:tinbot]] that provides a Firewall. Check the Unit Profile for the listed MOD.

records.name: TinBot: Neurocinetics
records.summary: A [[equipment:tinbot]] option with [[skill:neurocinetics]]. Check the Unit Profile for any listed MOD.

records.name: TinBot: Albedo
records.summary: A [[equipment:tinbot]] option with [[equipment:albedo]]. Check the Unit Profile for any listed MOD.

records.name: TinBot: Discover
records.summary: A [[equipment:tinbot]] option affecting [[skill:discover]]. Check the Unit Profile for the listed MOD.

records.name: TinBot: ECM Guided
records.summary: A [[equipment:tinbot]] option with [[equipment:ecm]] against Guided attacks. Check the Unit Profile for the listed MOD.

records.name: TinBot: Repeater
records.summary: A [[equipment:tinbot]] option with a [[equipment:repeater]]. Check the Unit Profile for any listed MOD.

records.name: Mimetism
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that imposes its listed negative MOD on enemy [[skill:bs-attack:plural]] requiring LoF and on [[skill:discover]] attempts against the user.

effects: Enemy [[skill:bs-attack:plural]] that require LoF and [[skill:discover]] attempts against the user apply the Mimetism MOD listed in the Unit Profile.
The Mimetism MOD does not apply to [[skill:cc-attack:plural]].
restrictions: Only the Mimetism MOD listed in the user's Unit Profile applies.

records.name: Multispectral Visor
records.summary: Automatic Equipment whose Level reduces [[skill:mimetism]] and Visibility Zone MODs, with higher Levels improving visibility handling and Level 3 adding further camouflage-countering effects.

effects: The Level listed for the user supplies its defined [[skill:mimetism]], Visibility Zone, [[ammunition:smoke|Smoke Ammunition]], and camouflage-countering effects.
Reduces [[skill:mimetism]] (-3) and Low Visibility Zone MODs to 0.
Reduces [[skill:mimetism]] (-6) and Poor Visibility Zone MODs to -3.
Allows the user to draw LoF through Zero Visibility Zones, applying a -6 MOD to Skills that require LoF.
The user does not make Face to Face Rolls against weapons using [[ammunition:smoke|Smoke Ammunition]].
Reduces MODs from [[skill:mimetism]] and Visibility Zones to 0.
Allows the user to draw LoF through Visibility Zones without applying those Zones' MODs to Skills that require LoF.
The user does not make Face to Face Rolls against weapons using [[ammunition:smoke|Smoke Ammunition]].
Reduces MODs from [[skill:mimetism]] and Visibility Zones to 0.
Allows the user to draw LoF through Visibility Zones without applying those Zones' MODs to Skills that require LoF.
The user does not make Face to Face Rolls against weapons using [[ammunition:smoke|Smoke Ammunition]].
A [[skill:discover]] WIP Roll against a target in [[state:camouflaged|Camouflaged State]] automatically succeeds.

Ignores [[skill:surprise-attack]] MODs when the user has LoF to the attacker, and also ignores [[skill:surprise-attack|Surprise Attack]] MODs from [[skill:cc-attack|CC Attacks]] without LoF to the attacker.

During the Active Turn, the user may declare a [[skill:bs-attack]] against a [[state:camouflaged|Camouflage Marker]] in LoF without first succeeding at [[skill:discover]]; the Marker's [[skill:mimetism]] MOD still applies and the usual [[state:camouflaged|Camouflaged State]] Cancellation clauses apply.

records.name: Combat Instinct
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that ignores [[skill:surprise-attack]] MODs and makes enemy [[skill:stealth]] ineffective against the user.

effects: The user ignores [[skill:surprise-attack]] MODs imposed by attackers.
[[skill:stealth]] is not effective against the user.
restrictions: The Skill affects only [[skill:surprise-attack]] MODs and [[skill:stealth]]; other MODs and ARO conditions still apply.

records.name: Sixth Sense
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that improves reactions to attacks from outside LoF and makes enemy [[skill:stealth]] ineffective against the user.

effects: The user can respond to Attacks directed at them from outside LoF, using a 360° LoF arc for those attackers; this also allows LoF to outside attackers while [[state:engaged|Engaged]].
When targeted by a [[skill:bs-attack]] through a Zero Visibility Zone, the user ignores the -6 MOD caused by the resulting Poor Visibility Zone.
[[skill:dodge]] and [[skill:reset]] ignore negative MODs except the specified [[state:immobilized-a|Immobilized-A]], [[state:immobilized-b|Immobilized-B]], and [[state:isolated]] penalties.
[[skill:stealth]] is not effective against the user.
restrictions: The Skill's response and MOD exceptions apply only in the situations it specifies.

records.name: Stealth
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that limits ARO generation when the user declares movement or [[skill:idle]], provided enemies lack LoF.

requirements: The user must be in the Active Turn.
effects: The user may declare [[skill:cautious-movement]] inside enemy Zones of Control and Hacking Areas.
[[skill:cautious-movement]], [[skill:idle]], and Basic Short Skills with the Movement Label grant AROs only to enemies that have LoF to the user.
Other declared Skills grant AROs normally.
If the user enters Silhouette contact without entering the enemy's LoF and then declares another Skill, that enemy's available AROs are restricted to the options allowed by the Stealth rule.
restrictions: Stealth does not prevent AROs when an enemy has LoF to the user or when the user declares another Skill.

records.name: Surprise Attack
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that imposes its listed negative MOD on targets' Face to Face ARO Rolls when attacking from Marker form or [[state:hidden-deployment|Hidden Deployment]].

requirements: The user must begin the Order in Marker form or [[state:hidden-deployment|Hidden Deployment]].
The user must declare a [[skill:cc-attack]], [[skill:bs-attack]], or Comms Attack during the Active Turn.
effects: The Attack imposes the negative Surprise Attack MOD shown in the Unit Profile on Face to Face Rolls made in ARO by targets of that Attack.
If the profile names a specific Attribute, the MOD applies only to that Attribute and does not stack with another Surprise Attack MOD.
restrictions: After use, Surprise Attack cannot be used again until the Trooper returns to Marker form.

records.name: Hidden Deployment State
records.summary: A deployment state in which a Trooper's position is recorded privately without placing a Model or Marker on the table.

effects: The Trooper is not placed on the table while the state is active and is generally treated as not being on the table.
The state is canceled when the Trooper is Discovered by a rule that explicitly allows it, such as [[skill:sensor]].
requirements: The Trooper has the [[skill:hidden-deployment]] Special Skill.
restrictions: Once canceled, Hidden Deployment State cannot be regained.

records.name: Hidden Deployment
records.summary: An optional Deployment Special Skill that lets the user deploy in [[state:hidden-deployment]].

effects: During the Deployment Phase, the user may deploy in [[state:hidden-deployment]].

records.name: Sensor
records.summary: A Short Special Skill that detects hidden threats in the user's Zone of Control and improves [[skill:discover]] against [[skill:camouflage]].

effects: The user may make a Normal WIP+6 Roll to simultaneously [[skill:discover]] enemy Troopers, Weapons, or Equipment in [[state:hidden-deployment|Hidden Deployment]] or [[state:camouflaged]] inside the user's Zone of Control.
The Sensor Roll does not apply Range or [[skill:mimetism]] MODs and does not require LoF or a designated target.
Enemies with the [[skill:camouflage]] Special Skill cannot regain [[state:camouflaged]] inside the user's Zone of Control.
The user gains +6 WIP when declaring [[skill:discover]] against Camouflage Markers.

records.name: Marksmanship
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill used with [[skill:bs-attack:plural]] that ignores negative BS MODs from Partial Cover and [[equipment:nanoscreen]].

requirements: The user can benefit from Marksmanship only when declaring a [[skill:bs-attack]].
effects: The user may ignore negative BS MODs imposed by Partial Cover and [[equipment:nanoscreen]].
restrictions: Only the negative BS MODs from Partial Cover and [[equipment:nanoscreen]] are ignored.

records.name: Baggage
records.summary: Automatic Equipment that lets nearby Allied Troopers reload eligible Disposable items and recover from [[state:unloaded]].

requirements: The Baggage holder and the affected Allied Trooper must both be in non-Null States, and the affected Allied Trooper must be inside the Baggage holder's Zone of Control.
effects: The affected Trooper may use [[skill:reload]] to cancel [[state:unloaded]] or regain all expended uses of eligible Disposable Weapons or Equipment.
During the States Phase, each eligible Allied Trooper in range may automatically receive the same recovery.
restrictions: Only one Allied Trooper can receive the [[skill:reload]] effect per Order.
[[trait:non-reloadable|Non-Reloadable]] items cannot regain uses or cancel their [[state:unloaded]] through this effect.
Recovering uses does not affect items already deployed on the table.

records.name: Albedo
records.summary: Automatic Equipment whose listed negative MOD affects enemy [[equipment:multispectral-visor]] or [[skill:marksmanship]] users attacking or Discovering the bearer.

effects: An enemy with a [[equipment:multispectral-visor]] or [[skill:marksmanship]] that declares a LoF-requiring [[skill:bs-attack]] or [[skill:discover]] against the bearer applies the listed Albedo negative MOD to the relevant Attribute.
The Albedo MOD does not apply to [[skill:cc-attack:plural]].

records.name: Natural Born Warrior
records.summary: An Automatic CC Special Skill that lets the user ignore negative MODs imposed by the opposing Trooper during a CC Face to Face Roll.

requirements: The user must be the target of a [[skill:cc-attack]] and must declare a [[skill:cc-attack]].
effects: In the resulting CC Face to Face Roll, the user ignores all negative MODs imposed by the opposing Trooper.
restrictions: The effect applies only to negative MODs imposed by the opposing Trooper in that CC Face to Face Roll.

records.name: Limited Cover
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that removes the target's -3 BS MOD for Partial Cover while leaving other applicable Cover effects intact.

effects: Attacks against the Trooper do not apply the -3 BS MOD granted by Partial Cover.
restrictions: Other applicable Partial Cover effects remain in force.

records.name: Non-Hackable
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that prevents Unit-Type-dependent Hacking Attacks from targeting the user.

effects: The user cannot be targeted by Hacking Attacks whose Requirements depend on the target having a specific Unit Type.
The Skill remains active while the user is in a Null State.
restrictions: The protection applies to Hacking Attacks whose Requirements specify a Unit Type; it does not create a general immunity to every Hacking effect.

records.name: No Cover
records.summary: An Automatic Special Skill that prevents the Trooper from benefiting from any MODs granted by Partial Cover.

effects: The Trooper cannot benefit from any MODs granted by Partial Cover.
When No Cover and [[skill:limited-cover]] both apply, the more severe No Cover restriction takes precedence.
restrictions: The restriction applies only to MODs granted by Partial Cover.

records.name: Forward Observer
records.summary: A Special Skill that makes a WIP-based [[skill:bs-attack]] and places a successfully affected target in [[state:targeted]].

requirements: The user must be able to draw LoF to the target.
effects: Forward Observer is a [[skill:bs-attack]] using a [[trait:bs-weapon-wip|BS Weapon (WIP)]]; instead of forcing a Saving Roll, a successful attack causes the target to enter [[state:targeted]].

records.name: Dodge
records.summary: A Common Skill used to evade Attacks, reposition slightly, and cancel [[state:engaged|Engaged]] or [[state:immobilized-a]] on a successful PH Roll.

requirements: The user must be the Active Trooper or be allowed to declare an ARO.
effects: Dodge uses PH to evade enemy Attacks during the Order or ARO; a successful Dodge may also move the user up to [[distance:2:inch]].
A successful Normal or Face to Face Dodge Roll cancels the user's [[state:immobilized-a]], applying any State-specific MODs.
restrictions: Dodge does not evade Comms Attacks; [[skill:reset]] is used for those instead.

records.name: Reset
records.summary: A Common Skill used to oppose Comms Attacks and Guided attacks and to cancel [[state:targeted|Targeted]], [[state:immobilized-b|Immobilized-B]], or [[state:isolated]].

requirements: The user must be the Active Trooper or be allowed to declare an ARO.
effects: Reset uses WIP to oppose enemy Comms Attacks and [[skill:bs-attack:plural]] (Guided); otherwise it is a Normal WIP Roll.
A successful Reset Roll cancels the user's [[state:targeted|Targeted]], [[state:immobilized-b|Immobilized-B]], or [[state:isolated]], applying any State-specific MODs.
restrictions: Reset does not evade other types of Attacks; [[skill:dodge]] is used for those instead.

records.name: Cautious Movement
records.summary: A Long Common Skill that can move a Trooper without generating enemy AROs when its start and end positions satisfy the rule's visibility and proximity limits.

effects: The Trooper may move up to the first MOV value without generating enemy AROs when the movement begins and ends outside the required enemy LoF, Zone of Control, and applicable Hacking Areas.
restrictions: TAGs, Remotes, Vehicles, Troopers with [[equipment:motorcycle:plural]], Troopers with [[skill:aerial]], and Troopers in [[state:targeted]] cannot declare Cautious Movement.

records.name: Alert
records.summary: An Automatic Common Skill that lets an eligible Trooper turn at the end of an Order after a nearby Attack.

requirements: The user or an Allied Trooper in its Zone of Control was the target of an Attack.
The user has not activated in the same Order.
effects: At the end of the Order, the user may turn on the spot without changing position or generating AROs.

records.name: Climb
records.summary: A Long Common Skill used to move on vertical surfaces.

requirements: The user must be in base contact with a vertical surface.
At least half of the user's base must remain in contact with the surface while moving.
The movement must finish on a surface at least as large as the base.
effects: The user moves on the vertical surface up to its first MOV value plus [[distance:2:inch]]; a Climb distance listed in the Unit Profile replaces the [[distance:2:inch]] bonus.
restrictions: Climb only permits movement on vertical surfaces and follows the General Movement Rules.
While holding onto a vertical surface, the Trooper cannot declare Skills other than Climb.
A Trooper performing Climb or holding onto a vertical surface cannot benefit from Partial Cover MODs.

records.name: Idle
records.summary: A Common Skill that spends the declared action without another effect.

effects: The user performs no action, although the declaration still activates the Trooper and may generate AROs.
A declared Skill whose Requirements are not met is resolved as Idle instead.

records.name: Intuitive Attack
records.summary: A Long Common Skill that uses a BS Weapon with the [[trait:intuitive-attack|Intuitive Attack]] Trait against a target that normally cannot be attacked directly.

requirements: The user must employ a BS Weapon with the [[trait:intuitive-attack|Intuitive Attack]] Trait.
The target must be outside the user's LoF because of a Zero Visibility Zone, or be in a State that normally requires [[skill:discover]] before it can be attacked.
effects: The user makes an unmodified WIP Roll; on success, the user performs a single [[skill:bs-attack]] Roll against the target with Burst 1.
restrictions: MODs from Partial Cover, Special Skills, Equipment, and other sources do not apply to the required WIP Roll.
After a failed WIP Roll, the user cannot attempt another Intuitive Attack against the same target until the next Active Turn.

records.name: Jump
records.summary: A Long Common Skill used to clear obstacles and move through the air.

requirements: The user must be able to reach a horizontal landing surface at least as large as its base.
effects: The user may Jump up to its first MOV value plus [[distance:2:inch]]; a Jump distance listed in the Unit Profile replaces the [[distance:2:inch]] bonus.
Declaring Jump automatically cancels [[state:prone]].
restrictions: The trajectory and landing must follow the Jump and General Movement Rules.
The user cannot benefit from Partial Cover MODs during an Order in which it declared Jump.

records.name: Move
records.summary: A Common Skill used to move a Trooper up to its applicable MOV value.

effects: The user moves up to the applicable MOV value.
restrictions: Movement must follow the general movement rules.

records.name: Look Out
records.summary: An ARO Common Skill that lets the user warn other Troopers so they can turn to face an acting enemy.

requirements: The user must have LoF to an enemy Trooper or Marker that declares or performs an Order.
effects: Other Troopers of the same player may modify their LoF by making [[skill:dodge]] (PH-3) Rolls in the same Order.
restrictions: An alerted Trooper may make the [[skill:dodge]] (PH-3) Roll only if it has not declared another ARO.

records.name: Place Deployable
records.summary: A Common Skill used to place eligible [[trait:deployable]] Weapons or Equipment, or [[skill:peripheral]] (Ancillary) items, on the table.

requirements: The user must have a Weapon or Equipment item with the Deployable Label, or a [[skill:peripheral]] (Ancillary).
In the Reactive Turn, the user must have LoF to the Active Trooper.
effects: The user places one eligible Token or Model without a Roll; it becomes active at the Conclusion of the Order.
restrictions: Placement must follow the active/reactive placement, support, and Deployment restrictions of Place Deployable.
A Deployable Weapon cannot be placed with an enemy Camouflaged Marker inside its Trigger Area unless the documented exception applies.

records.name: Reload
records.summary: A Common Skill that cancels [[state:unloaded]] or restores expended Disposable uses when its requirements are met.

requirements: The user and the Allied Trooper or game element with [[equipment:baggage]] must both be in non-Null States, and the user must be inside that [[equipment:baggage]] holder's Zone of Control.
The user is in [[state:unloaded]] or has expended uses of a Disposable Weapon or piece of Equipment.
effects: Without a Roll, the user cancels [[state:unloaded]] or regains all expended uses of eligible Disposable Weapons or Equipment.
restrictions: Only one Allied Trooper can receive this effect per Order.
Recovering Disposable uses does not affect Weapons or Equipment already deployed on the table.
[[trait:non-reloadable|Non-Reloadable]] Weapons or Equipment cannot cancel [[state:unloaded]] or regain expended uses through Reload.

records.name: Request Speedball
records.summary: An Automatic Common Skill that calls airborne support by placing two Speedball Tokens.

requirements: The player must have two Speedball Tokens.
effects: During the Active Turn, place two 55 mm Speedball Tokens using the [[skill:combat-jump]] rules and make a PH 15 Roll for each token.
restrictions: Request Speedball cannot be performed partway through the Order Expenditure Sequence.

records.name: Speculative Attack
records.summary: A Long Common Skill that uses a BS Weapon with the [[trait:speculative-attack|Speculative Attack]] Trait to attack without LoF.

requirements: The user must employ a BS Weapon with the [[trait:speculative-attack|Speculative Attack]] Trait.
A valid trajectory must exist between the user and the chosen impact point.
effects: The user makes a single [[skill:bs-attack]] with Burst 1 against a target outside LoF; eligible Circular Templates may use a separate impact point that still affects the Main Target.
restrictions: Apply the Speculative Attack -6 MOD and Range MODs; other negative MODs such as [[skill:mimetism]], Partial Cover, and Visibility Zones are not applied.
A Circular Template impact point cannot be placed on a vertical surface or in the air.

records.name: Suppressive Fire
records.summary: A Long Common Skill that places the user in [[state:suppressive-fire]] with a selected weapon.

requirements: The user must select a Weapon with the [[trait:suppressive-fire|Suppressive Fire]] Trait.
effects: The user enters [[state:suppressive-fire]] using the selected Weapon.

records.name: Unconscious State
records.summary: A Null State entered when a Trooper has received as many Wounds as its VITA or STR Attribute.

effects: The Trooper cannot declare Orders or AROs and does not contribute an Order during the Tactical Phase.
Automatic Special Skills and Automatic Equipment have no effect while the state is active.
Removing a Wound so the Trooper has fewer Wounds than its VITA or STR value cancels the state.

records.name: Disconnected State
records.summary: A Null State in which a Peripheral cannot activate while separated from or disabled through its Controller relationship.

effects: The Peripheral cannot be activated or declare Orders or AROs.
Automatic Special Skills and Automatic Equipment have no effect except for the [[skill:peripheral]] Special Skill.
[[skill:engineer]] can cancel the state when it was caused directly by an Attack, scenery, or a Scenario Special Rule.

records.name: Immobilized-A State
records.summary: A restrictive State that normally limits the Trooper to [[skill:dodge]] at PH -6.

effects: The Trooper cannot declare Skills or AROs except [[skill:dodge]], applying a -6 PH MOD.
A successful qualifying [[skill:dodge]] or an [[skill:engineer]] WIP Roll can cancel the state.

records.name: Immobilized-B State
records.summary: A restrictive State that normally limits the Trooper to [[skill:reset]] at WIP -3.

effects: The Trooper cannot declare Skills, Attacks, or AROs except [[skill:reset]], applying a -3 WIP MOD.
A successful qualifying [[skill:reset]] or an [[skill:engineer]] WIP Roll can cancel the state.

records.name: Isolated State
records.summary: A State that cuts a Trooper off from its Order Pool and disables its Comms-related capabilities.

effects: The Trooper cannot receive Orders from its Order Pool and becomes Irregular in following Active Turns while still Isolated.
Comms Attack and Comms Equipment capabilities, including Hacking Programs, are disabled.
[[skill:reset]] is made at WIP -9; a successful qualifying [[skill:reset]] or [[skill:engineer]] WIP Roll can cancel the state.
restrictions: An Isolated Trooper cannot be part of a Fireteam or take part in a Coordinated Order.

records.name: Stunned State
records.summary: A temporary State that prevents Attacks and applies a -3 MOD to most Rolls.

effects: The Trooper cannot declare Attacks and applies a -3 MOD to Rolls other than Saving Rolls.
[[skill:doctor]] can cancel the state for VITA targets and [[skill:engineer]] can cancel it for STR targets.
The state also cancels automatically at the start of the States Phase of the Player Turn in which it was caused.

records.name: Targeted State
records.summary: A State that makes the Trooper easier to attack or [[skill:discover]] and interferes with [[skill:reset]], [[skill:cautious-movement]], and [[skill:stealth]].

effects: [[skill:bs-attack]], Comms Attack, and [[skill:discover]] against the Trooper gain a +3 MOD to the Attribute used.
The Trooper applies a -3 WIP MOD to [[skill:reset]].
A successful qualifying [[skill:reset]] or an [[skill:engineer]] WIP Roll can cancel the state.
restrictions: The Trooper cannot declare [[skill:cautious-movement]] or use the [[skill:stealth]] Special Skill.

records.name: Unloaded State
records.summary: An item-specific State entered when a Disposable Weapon or Equipment item exhausts its uses or ammunition.

effects: The relevant Weapon or Equipment item cannot be used while Unloaded State is active.
Reloading cancels the state and restores the item's uses unless a rule such as [[trait:non-reloadable|Non-Reloadable]] says otherwise.

records.name: 360º Visor
records.summary: Automatic Equipment that expands the user's Line of Fire arc to 360º instead of the usual 180º.

effects: The user has a 360º LoF arc instead of the usual 180º arc.

records.name: Nanoscreen
records.summary: Automatic Equipment that protects its user against eligible [[skill:bs-attack:plural]] by penalizing the attacker and improving the user's Saving Rolls.

requirements: The user must be the target of a [[skill:bs-attack]].
effects: A -3 BS MOD is imposed on [[skill:bs-attack]] Rolls against the user.
+3 applies to the user's Saving Rolls against those [[skill:bs-attack:plural]].
restrictions: The MODs do not apply to [[skill:bs-attack:plural]] with the Comms. Attack Trait.
Nanoscreen cannot be used against [[skill:cc-attack:plural]].

records.name: X-Visor
records.summary: Automatic Equipment that improves the user's negative Range MODs for ranged attacks and other Range-band actions.

effects: For the user's BS Weapons, Special Skills, and Equipment, a -3 Range MOD becomes 0 and a -6 Range MOD becomes -3.
The same benefit applies to Common Skills with Range bands, including [[skill:discover]] and [[skill:suppressive-fire]].

records.name: Biometric Visor
records.summary: Automatic Equipment that counters [[state:impersonation-1|Impersonation-1 State]] penalties and qualifying [[skill:surprise-attack]] MODs from [[state:impersonation-1|Impersonation-1 State]], [[state:impersonation-2|Impersonation-2 State]], and [[state:holoecho|Holoecho State]].

effects: The user ignores the WIP -3 MOD imposed by [[state:impersonation-1]].
A successful [[skill:discover]] Roll against a Trooper in [[state:impersonation-1]] cancels that Impersonation State.

The user ignores [[skill:surprise-attack]] MODs from attackers benefiting from [[state:impersonation-1|Impersonation-1 State]], [[state:impersonation-2|Impersonation-2 State]], or [[state:holoecho|Holoecho State]] when the rule conditions are met.
restrictions: The [[skill:surprise-attack]] protection is conditional on the attacker benefiting from [[state:impersonation-1|Impersonation-1 State]], [[state:impersonation-2|Impersonation-2 State]], or [[state:holoecho|Holoecho State]]; LoF is normally required, except against qualifying [[skill:cc-attack:plural]].

records.name: Dazer
records.summary: Equipment with the [[trait:deployable]] Trait that creates a Difficult Terrain area inside its Zone of Control.

effects: A deployed Dazer generates a Difficult Terrain area of infinite height inside its Zone of Control.
Troopers with [[skill:terrain]] (Total) ignore the Dazer and apply their [[skill:terrain]] MOD when declaring Skills with the Movement Label.
A deployed Dazer remains on the table until the end of the game or until destroyed.

records.name: Deactivator
records.summary: A Short Skill Equipment action that removes enemy deployed Weapons or Equipment after a successful WIP Roll.

requirements: The target must be inside the user's Line of Fire or Zone of Control.
The target must be an enemy Weapon or piece of Equipment with the [[trait:deployable]] Trait, and cannot be a Camouflage Marker.
effects: On a successful Normal WIP Roll, the target deployed Weapon or Equipment is removed from the game table.
restrictions: The WIP Roll applies Range MODs only; Special Skill MODs such as [[skill:mimetism]] and Cover MODs are not applied.
Passing the Roll does not prevent the target from triggering during the current Order.

records.name: Deployable Cover
records.summary: Equipment with the [[trait:deployable]] Trait that places a Scenery Element providing variant-specific Cover effects.

effects: [[skill:place-deployable]] places the Deployable Cover Scenery Element completely inside the user's Zone of Control.
Deployable Cover allows Partial Cover to be applied subject to the selected variant.
Cutting Foam prevents enemy Troopers from claiming Partial Cover from that Deployable Cover.
Vitroferro removes the usual -3 Cover MOD from the attacker's [[skill:bs-attack]] Roll and instead improves the benefiting Trooper's Saving Roll by +6, subject to the documented cap.
restrictions: The player must declare the available Cutting Foam or Vitroferro variant when [[skill:place-deployable]] is declared.

records.name: Repeater
records.summary: Automatic Comms Equipment that extends allied Hacking Areas and can also be used by enemy [[skill:hacker:plural]] with Firewall MODs.

effects: The Repeater extends the Hacking Area of all [[skill:hacker:plural]] in the same Army List.
Enemy [[skill:hacker:plural]] inside its Zone of Control may use the Repeater to apply Hacking Programs against enemy [[skill:hacker:plural]], applying the documented Firewall MODs.
restrictions: The owner cannot voluntarily deactivate the Repeater; it becomes inactive when its carrier is [[state:isolated|Isolated]] or in a Null State.

records.name: Deployable Repeater
records.summary: Comms Equipment with the [[trait:deployable]] Trait that places a [[equipment:repeater]] on the battlefield using [[skill:place-deployable]].

effects: [[skill:place-deployable]] places a Deployable Repeater Token on the game table.
The deployed Equipment contains a [[equipment:repeater]] and applies the [[equipment:repeater]] rule while active.

records.name: FastPanda
records.summary: Self-propelled Equipment with the [[trait:deployable]] Trait that places a [[equipment:repeater]] anywhere completely inside the user's Zone of Control.

effects: When [[skill:place-deployable]] is declared, the FastPanda may be placed completely inside the user's Zone of Control instead of in Silhouette contact.
The deployed FastPanda contains a [[equipment:repeater]] and applies the [[equipment:repeater]] rule while active.
The deployed FastPanda remains on the table until the end of the game or until destroyed.

records.name: AI Motorcycle
records.summary: Automatic Equipment that uses [[equipment:motorcycle]] rules while mounted and becomes a [[skill:peripheral]] (Synchronized) when the rider dismounts.

effects: The mounted profile applies the [[equipment:motorcycle]] Equipment rules.
The dismounted profile applies [[skill:peripheral]] (Synchronized) to the AI Motorcycle and uses [[skill:transmutation]] (Auto) to change between mounted and dismounted profiles.
restrictions: The Trooper cannot return to the mounted profile while the Peripheral is [[state:isolated|Isolated]], Immobilized, or in a Null State.
Supportware affecting the Peripheral is canceled for the Trooper when the mounted profile is applied.

records.name: Bangbomb
records.summary: Optional Automatic Equipment that applies its listed positive MOD to eligible [[skill:dodge]] Rolls against nearby enemy attacks.

requirements: The user declares [[skill:dodge]].
effects: Apply the MOD listed after Bangbomb in the Unit Profile to eligible [[skill:dodge]] Rolls.
restrictions: The MOD only applies against attacks declared by enemy Troopers inside the user’s LoF or Zone of Control.
The MOD does not apply against Template Weapon attacks.

records.name: ECM
records.summary: Automatic Equipment that imposes the listed negative MOD on enemy attacks of the type specified in the bearer’s Unit Profile.

requirements: The owner is the target of the Attack type listed in brackets after ECM in the Unit Profile.
effects: The Enemy applies the listed negative ECM MOD when attempting that Attack against the owner.

records.name: Escape System
records.summary: Army Equipment identity whose game effect is defined by the [[skill:transmutation]] (Escape System-X) rules for changing to the alternate Unit Profile.

effects: When the Escape System threshold is reached, the Trooper changes to the alternate Unit Profile under [[skill:transmutation]] (Escape System-X).
The profile change places an Eclipse Special Ammo Circular Template centered on the replacement Model.
restrictions: The threshold is the value listed after [[equipment:escape-system]] in the Unit Profile.

records.name: EVO Hacking Device
records.summary: Automatic Comms Equipment that grants access to the EVO support Hacking Programs.

effects: Allows the use of [[hacking-program:assisted-fire]], [[hacking-program:controlled-jump]], [[hacking-program:enhanced-reaction]], and [[hacking-program:fairy-dust]] Hacking Programs.

records.name: GizmoKit
records.summary: Short-Skill Equipment that repairs allied Models with STR by removing a Wound on a successful target PH Roll.

requirements: The target is an Allied Model with the STR Attribute.
Remote use requires LoF; contact use requires Silhouette contact.
effects: Remote use is a [[trait:non-lethal|Non-Lethal]] BS Weapon; contact use spends a Short Skill without an attack Roll.
On a successful target PH Roll, remove one Wound and cancel [[state:unconscious]] if applicable.
On a failed target PH Roll, the target receives a Wound instead.

records.name: Hacking Device
records.summary: Automatic Comms Equipment that grants access to the standard offensive and control Hacking Programs.

effects: Allows the use of [[hacking-program:carbonite]], [[hacking-program:oblivion]], [[hacking-program:spotlight]], and [[hacking-program:total-control]] Hacking Programs.

records.name: Hacking Device Plus
records.summary: Automatic Comms Equipment that expands the standard [[equipment:hacking-device]] program set with [[hacking-program:cybermask]] and [[hacking-program:white-noise]].

effects: Allows the use of [[hacking-program:carbonite]], [[hacking-program:cybermask]], [[hacking-program:oblivion]], [[hacking-program:spotlight]], [[hacking-program:total-control]], and [[hacking-program:white-noise]] Hacking Programs.

records.name: Holomask
records.summary: Optional Automatic Equipment that lets its user deploy in or enter [[state:holomask]].

effects: During Deployment, the user may deploy in [[state:holomask]].
During the game, the user may enter [[state:holomask]].

records.name: Holoprojector
records.summary: Optional NFB Automatic Equipment that lets its user deploy in or enter [[state:holoecho]].

effects: When placed on the table, the bearer may deploy in [[state:holoecho]].
During the game, the user may enter [[state:holoecho]].

records.name: Killer Hacking Device
records.summary: Automatic Comms Equipment specialized for [[hacking-program:cybermask]] and [[hacking-program:trinity]] Hacking Programs.

effects: Allows the use of [[hacking-program:cybermask]] and [[hacking-program:trinity]] Hacking Programs.

records.name: MediKit
records.summary: Short-Skill Equipment that can recover allied Models with VITA from [[state:unconscious]] through a target PH Roll.

requirements: The target is an Allied Model with the VITA Attribute in [[state:unconscious]], unless a scenario rule says otherwise.
Remote use requires LoF; contact use requires Silhouette contact.
effects: Remote use is a [[trait:non-lethal|Non-Lethal]] BS Weapon; contact use spends a Short Skill without an attack Roll.
On a successful target PH Roll, remove one Wound and cancel [[state:unconscious]].
On a failed target PH Roll, the target enters [[state:dead]].

records.name: Motorcycle
records.summary: Automatic Equipment whose mounted movement rules restrict [[skill:climb]], [[skill:cautious-movement]], upward [[skill:jump]] movement, and entry into [[state:prone]].

restrictions: A mounted Trooper cannot enter [[state:prone]].
A mounted Trooper cannot declare [[skill:climb]] or use ladders.
A mounted Trooper cannot [[skill:jump]] vertically or diagonally upward; horizontal and downward [[skill:jump]] movement remains allowed.
A mounted Trooper cannot declare [[skill:cautious-movement]].

records.name: SymbioMate
records.summary: Single-use assignable Equipment that temporarily replaces the user’s ARM and BTS with 9 and grants [[skill:immunity]] (Enhanced) for eligible Saving Rolls.

requirements: The SymbioMate must be used when its assigned user is forced to make a Saving Roll.
effects: For ARM/BTS Saving Rolls during the Order, use ARM/BTS 9 and apply [[skill:immunity]] (Enhanced) when applicable.
Against Comms Attacks, ARM/BTS 9 applies but [[skill:immunity]] (Enhanced) does not.
Remove the SymbioMate at the end of the Order in which it is used.

records.name: Combat Jump
records.summary: A Long Special Skill that keeps the user off-table until they attempt an airborne landing during their Active Turn.

effects: The user may remain off-table after Deployment and later spend their own Order to enter the table.
The user is placed on a valid horizontal landing surface and makes the Combat Jump PH Roll; a successful Roll keeps that position.
A failed landing moves the user to the player's Deployment Zone edge and removes any Weapons or Equipment with the [[trait:deployable]] Trait placed with the attempted landing.
Combat Jump (Explosion) adds a single-use PS 8 Normal Direct Template Attack after the landing position is resolved.
restrictions: The landing cannot place the user [[state:prone|Prone]], in prohibited Silhouette contact, inside enclosed scenery, or in contact with a scenario objective.
The user cannot benefit from Partial Cover during the Order in which Combat Jump is used.

records.name: Decoy
records.summary: A Deployment Skill that lets the user deploy with false replicas represented through [[state:decoy]].

effects: When placed on the table, the user may deploy in [[state:decoy]].
The value shown with Decoy determines whether one or two replica Decoys may be placed.

records.name: Impersonation
records.summary: A Deployment Skill that lets the user deploy forward while disguised in an Impersonation Marker State.

effects: The user may deploy outside the enemy Deployment Zone in [[state:impersonation-1]].
The user may attempt a WIP Roll to deploy inside the enemy Deployment Zone.
A profile with Impersonation ([[state:impersonation-2|IMP-2]]) deploys and activates only [[state:impersonation-2]].
restrictions: A failed WIP Roll places the user in their own Deployment Zone at the table edge as a Model and removes Weapons or Equipment with the [[trait:deployable]] Trait placed with the attempt.
The user cannot deploy in prohibited contact with enemy or neutral game elements or mission objectives.

records.name: Infiltration
records.summary: A Deployment Skill that allows forward deployment in the user's half and a PH-based attempt to deploy into the opponent's half.

effects: During Deployment, the user may deploy anywhere in the player's half of the table.
Deploying in the opponent's half requires the Infiltration Roll, normally PH-3, with any profile-specific PH replacement applied as stated.
If the Roll fails, the user is moved to their own Deployment Zone edge and Weapons or Equipment with the [[trait:deployable]] Trait placed with the attempt are removed.
restrictions: Infiltration cannot be used to deploy inside the enemy Deployment Zone.
After a failed Infiltration Roll, the attempted deployment cannot remain in Marker or [[state:hidden-deployment]].

records.name: Minelayer
records.summary: A Deployment Skill that lets the user place carried Weapons or Equipment with the [[trait:deployable]] Trait near their deployment position.

requirements: The Weapon or Equipment with the [[trait:deployable]] Trait must satisfy the normal Deployment conditions and remain within the area where the Minelayer user may deploy.
Its Trigger Area or the area defined by the [[trait:perimeter]] Trait must satisfy the rule's enemy-presence restrictions when placed.
effects: When the user deploys, they may place the allowed number of carried Weapons or Equipment with the [[trait:deployable]] Trait inside their Zone of Control.
Placing an item with the Disposable Trait consumes the corresponding available use.
If the user's Superior Deployment Roll fails, a Minelayer item placed with that deployment is removed and any Disposable use is consumed.

records.name: Parachutist
records.summary: A Long Special Skill that keeps the user off-table until they enter from a valid table-edge position during their Active Turn.

effects: The user may remain off-table after Deployment and later spend their own Order to enter the table.
The entry point must be on a surface large enough for the base and in contact with the table edge.
Parachutist (Deployment Zone) permits entry within the enemy Deployment Zone.
restrictions: Without the Deployment Zone variant, the user cannot enter inside the enemy Deployment Zone.
The entry cannot place the user [[state:prone|Prone]] or in prohibited contact with enemy or neutral game elements or mission objectives.
The user cannot benefit from Partial Cover during the Order in which Parachutist is used.

records.name: Sapper
records.summary: A Deployment/Long Special Skill that lets its user begin or later enter [[state:foxhole]].

requirements: The space used to enter [[state:foxhole]] must accommodate that State's Silhouette.
effects: During Deployment, the user may begin in [[state:foxhole]].
During the Active Turn, the user may spend a Long Skill to enter [[state:foxhole]].
restrictions: If the required space is unavailable, the attempted Active-Turn use becomes [[skill:idle]] instead.

records.name: Strategic Deployment
records.summary: A Deployment Skill that grants [[skill:forward-deployment]] to its user and the rest of that user's Fireteam during deployment.

requirements: The user must be the first Fireteam member deployed and must deploy as that Fireteam's Team Leader.
effects: The user and the rest of their Fireteam deploy as if they had [[skill:forward-deployment]] ([[distance:+4:inch]]).

If a scenario or tournament rule already grants [[skill:forward-deployment]] ([[distance:+4:inch]]) to a Fireteam member, the Fireteam instead applies [[skill:forward-deployment]] ([[distance:+8:inch]]).

records.name: Decoy State
records.summary: A deployment Marker State that conceals which of several colocated replicas represents the real user.

effects: The user deploys with one or two replica Decoys in Coherency, according to the [[skill:decoy]] value.
The controlling player secretly records which representation is the real user.
Replica Decoys are removed by successful [[skill:discover]], a successful Attack, or prohibited Silhouette contact; revealing the real user removes the remaining replicas.
requirements: The Trooper has the [[skill:decoy]] Special Skill.
restrictions: A Trooper using [[skill:decoy]] cannot remain part of a Fireteam or participate in a Coordinated Order.
The real user is revealed by the State's listed revealing declarations, failed deployment Rolls, enemy Silhouette contact, or forced Saving Rolls.

records.name: Impersonation-1 State
records.summary: The stronger Impersonation Marker State, which represents the user as an apparent ally and requires a penalized [[skill:discover]] Roll to reduce.

effects: The Model is replaced by an IMP-1 Marker and enemies perceive it as Allied.
A normal successful [[skill:discover]] Roll against IMP-1 applies the State's WIP -3 MOD and changes the user to [[state:impersonation-2]].
requirements: The Trooper can activate Impersonation-1 State through [[skill:impersonation]] or another qualifying rule.
restrictions: Attacks and [[skill:intuitive-attack:plural]] cannot be declared against an IMP-1 Marker under the normal [[state:impersonation-1|Impersonation-1 State]] rules.
A Trooper in Impersonation State cannot be part of a Fireteam.

records.name: Impersonation-2 State
records.summary: The second Impersonation Marker State, which still disguises the user but is removed by a successful unmodified [[skill:discover]] Roll.

effects: The Model is replaced by an IMP-2 Marker and enemies perceive it as Allied.
A successful [[skill:discover]] Roll removes IMP-2 and replaces the Marker with the corresponding Model.
requirements: The Trooper can activate Impersonation-2 State through [[skill:impersonation]] or another qualifying rule.
restrictions: Attacks and [[skill:intuitive-attack:plural]] cannot normally be declared against an IMP-2 Marker until it is Discovered.
A Trooper in Impersonation State cannot be part of a Fireteam.

records.name: Foxhole State
records.summary: A fixed fortified State that changes the user's Silhouette, grants all-round Partial Cover and [[skill:mimetism]], and prevents movement while active.
